newsitem.title: UK: UK's Labour to reassure Japanese over Europe - paper.
newsitem.headline: UK's Labour to reassure Japanese over Europe - paper.

text.p: Britain will send a senior delegation to Japan this weekend in a bid to reassure investors there about the Labour government's policies over Europe, the Times newspaper said on Wednesday.

It said British Trade and Industry Secretary Margaret Beckett would lead the delegation to rebut charges by the opposition Conservative party that Labour's policies would slash investment in Britain by Japan and other countries.
Beckett will hold talks with Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto and senior ministers from the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of International Trade and Industry, the paper said.

During the campaign for the May 1 election the Conservatives said Labour's desire to sign up to the European Union's Social Charter would boost industry costs and thereby drive away investors attracted by Britain's relatively cheap labour.
